latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker for Laptop Free.

- Instantly edit and export video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) directly from your laptop browser.
- Cloud GPU backend processes your edits and exports polished 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- No registration required for first use—anonymous login with 100 free credits.
- Session-based workflow: upload, trim, add transitions, and export videos with simple prompts.
- Built-in support for checking credits, exporting, uploading, and querying status.
- Error and session handling guides users through token renewal, file limits, and format issues.
